metadata.title: Fried Tapioca
metadata.description:
Click to tweet and share this recipe: http://ctt.ec/727Ul

Tapioca used to be the staple diet for many tribal communities in Northeastern India. Nowadays, though it's not consumed as a staple, it's grown commonly and is prepared differently in different regions. This is a classic tea time snack recipe that my mother makes by deep or shallow frying the pressure cooked and soft Tapioca. This has a very distinct taste as it's crispy and tastes like chips on the outside and is soft like a potato wedge on the inside. You can choose to have this with dip or chutney of your choice.
